每一项人工智能突破的背后都隐藏着更为关键的因素：能源。

每个模型、每个查询、每个突破的背后都隐藏着不断扩大的实体系统，其中包括数据中心、计算设备、冷却设施以及电力设施。而这一系统正在迅速扩展。

与此同时，人工智能正逐渐成为经济实力新架构的一部分。

预计在 2026 至 2035 年间，将有约 5.8 万亿美元的资金流入电网基础设施领域，其中大约 7000 亿美元将用于数字电网技术。这显然为各国提供了一个切入点，使其能够在这场人工智能投资浪潮中占据一席之地，而不仅仅是作为数字基础设施的承载者，还要成为驱动这些基础设施运转的能源系统的构建者。

我即将参加由全球能源互联发展与合作组织、联合国开发计划署、REN21和CEET共同主办的线上边会活动，该活动将在联合国科学、技术与创新论坛上举行，旨在探讨这一重要议题

推动一场人工智能革命——构建互联电力基础设施作为能源转型之路


🗓2026年5月6日，星期三

🕒东部时间上午 9 点至 10 点 15 分（纽约）/北京时间晚上 21 点至 22 点 15 分

⚡加入在线讨论：https://lnkd.in/e3WEQuys

Behind every AI breakthrough sits something far more decisive: energy.

Behind every model, every query, every breakthrough sits a growing physical system of data centres, compute, cooling, and power. And that system is expanding fast.

At the same time, AI is becoming part of the new architecture of economic power.

Around $5.8 trillion is expected to flow into grid infrastructure between 2026 and 2035, including roughly $700 billion in digital grid technologies. This is a clear entry point for countries to position themselves in the AI investment wave, not just as hosts of digital infrastructure, but as builders of the energy systems that power it.

I will be joining an online side event co-organized by Global Energy Interconnection Development and Cooperation Organization, UNDP, REN21, and CEET at the UN Forum on Science, Technology and Innovation to explore this nexus:

Empowering an AI Revolution – Construction of Interconnected Power Infrastructure as the Path for Energy Transition


🗓 Wednesday, May 6, 2026

🕒 09:00–10:15 AM EST (New York) / 21:00–22:15 (Beijing time)
